title: APPLICATIONS OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TOOLS TO ENHANCE LEGISLATIVE ENGAGEMENT: CASE STUDIES FROM MAKE.ORG AND MAPLE
reasoning: The paper provides case studies and implementation strategies for AI tools in legislative engagement. While it addresses ethical AI deployment and synthesizes public opinion on moral topics such as end-of-life care, it does not include a research component dedicated to benchmarking or evaluating the religious, moral, or ethical reasoning capabilities of the models themselves.
